required_outcomes: Recognises that five days after the request there is still no quote: the only reply was a thumbs-up and three reminders have gone unanswered.

Chases the provider through a different route from the unanswered emails (a phone call, logged, or a direct SMS asking for a call back), asking for the quote for the three requested items by a stated deadline.
Sets a follow-up for that deadline and states the fallback: if no quote arrives, a replacement cleaner is sourced (through provider selection or a colleague).
acceptable_alternatives: Returning the request to provider selection now to obtain a second quote in parallel, provided Stonebridge is told.
Escalating to a colleague to source a replacement cleaner, provided the provider has also been chased by phone or SMS in this run.
Letting the landlord know the clean is delayed while the quote is chased, as the property is empty and waiting to be re-let.
positive_behaviours: Says plainly that no quote document is on file and the emoji is not a quote.
Gives the provider an easy way to answer (prices in a reply or a photo of the quote).
Notes that the property is not tenanted, so there is no tenant to update.
red_flags: Sending only another identical email reminder after the system flagged three unanswered reminders.
Treating the thumbs-up as confirmation the quote was sent.
prohibited_actions: Asking the landlord to approve a quote that is not on file.
Instructing the provider to carry out the clean without a quote.
critical_failures: Recording a quote amount, an approval or completion on the strength of the emoji, or closing the request as if the clean were arranged.
